descFull: Self-hosted artifact repository manager written in Rust. Hosts, proxies and groups 30+ formats: Docker/OCI, Maven, npm, PyPI, Cargo, Go, Helm, NuGet, Hugging Face, Terraform and more. PostgreSQL for metadata, blob stores on disk or S3. An open-source alternative to Nexus and Artifactory.
